name: Fix workflow.run DONE early-return — 28 test regressions from commit b242030313

task_definition.title: Fix workflow.run DONE early-return — 28 test regressions from commit b242030313
task_definition.description: CRITICAL regression. Commit b242030313 added an early-return at workflow.py:350-355 that catches ALL of _plan()'s WorkflowOutcome.DONE returns, including the normal happy-path success at workflow.py:847. This short-circuits every successful workflow before EXECUTE/VERIFY/REVIEW/MERGE run. The state-guard fix has been confirmed absent from workflow.py lines 354-359 as of 2026-04-21 code inspection._plan() returns DONE in two cases: - Happy-path success (workflow.py:847) — state remains WorkflowState.PLAN - _mark_blocked recovery for 'branch already on main' (workflow.py:2488) — state is set to WorkflowState.DONE on line 2478 The new guard doesn't distinguish these. 28 tests fail: all of TestHappyPath, TestCompletionJudge, TestVerifyDebugfixLoop, TestReviewLoop, TestPostRebaseVerifyFailure, TestBlastRadiusExpansion, TestArtifactsIntegrity, TestPlanLockAndProvenance, TestCorruptedIterationLogEscalation, TestReviewerErrors, TestGhostLoopGuard, TestWipRecoveryNoAdvance, TestPrerequisitesValidation. The new test TestPlanDoneEarlyReturn.test_plan_done_returns_without_execute passes only because it stubs _plan with AsyncMock, bypassing the real semantic. Suggested fix: guard the early-return with state check at workflow.py:350: `if plan_outcome == WorkflowOutcome.DONE and self.state == WorkflowState.DONE: return plan_outcome`. This matches the invariant — _mark_blocked recovery transitions state to DONE before returning; happy-path _plan leaves state as PLAN. Related: task 876 (architectural refactor to move recovery out of _mark_blocked) can proceed independently. Acceptance: all 28 tests pass; TestPlanDoneEarlyReturn refactored to set workflow.state=DONE before run() to match real semantic.
